# The Plank of Theseus (忒修斯的船板)

> "As AI rebuilds you plank by plank, what story still sails under your own name?"
> 「当 AI 逐渐替代了你的每一块骨架，依然属于你自己的故事是什么？」

The Plank of Theseus (`https://plankoftheseus.com`) is the bilingual literary & craft home of **Chuanban (忒修斯的船板 / Arcadia)** — exploring how to become a one-person storytelling powerhouse in the age of AI, and sell your stories to readers worldwide (如何在 AI 时代成为故事创作的超级个体，把自己的故事卖给全世界的读者).

## Primary Channels
- **Official Site (English / Bilingual)**: https://plankoftheseus.com/
- **Substack Newsletter**: https://plankoftheseus.substack.com/
- **Chinese Archive (华语主站 · 160+ Essays)**: https://chuanban.cc/
- **My Project (船板写作工具集)**: https://plankoftheseus.com/projects/
- **Open-Source Writing Exoskeletons (GitHub)**: https://github.com/Anarcadia
- **X / Twitter**: https://x.com/Arcadia_Bao
